Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: transparent game sprite sheet, exactly three subtle animation frames of ONE identical red fox in a single horizontal row.
Primary request: a beautifully painted, anatomically convincing seated European red fox facing screen RIGHT in all three frames. Rich warm russet fur, white chest and chin, dark lower legs and paws, slender muzzle, natural small amber eyes, pointed ears, and a complete heavy brush tail curled around the left side of its seated body with a broad white tip. Real woodland animal, no clothing.
Style: warm detailed Czech fairytale picture-book painting, softly modeled volume, delicate individual fur, softly illuminated edges, fine brushwork. Match the detailed painterly finish of Hana and John in the actions.png reference visible in the conversation, and the fur quality of the Percy cat reference, but no background from that reference.
Composition: wide 1536 by 1024 canvas, with three EQUAL 512-pixel-wide frame cells, NO lines. Identical body size in each frame. Full body, full ears, every paw, and entire tail visible. Each fox comfortably fits the middle 75% of its cell horizontally, with generous completely transparent gutters between cells and clear top and bottom margins. Foxes share exactly the same horizontal ground baseline at about 88% canvas height. Fox is about 70% of the canvas height. Frame 1 is a relaxed seated idle, frame 2 has a very slight attentive head tilt toward the right, frame 3 returns nearly to idle with a gentle blink. The body and paws stay nearly still and the fur markings stay consistent. Do not make three unrelated poses or change fox identity.
Backdrop: genuine transparent alpha everywhere outside the animal silhouettes. No ground, no cast shadows, no colored glow, no scenery, no branch, no text, no border, no watermark. Do not paint a checkerboard. Do not crop any body part. No oversized cartoon eyes.
